name: Metro Bank Holdings PLC
summary: Metro Bank Holdings PLC operates as the bank holding company for Metro Bank PLC that provides business, commercial, retail and private banking products and services in the United Kingdom. It offers personal banking products and services, including current, cash, and foreign currency accounts; savings; residential and buy-to-let mortgages; overdrafts; credit cards; and safe deposit box services.
